name: The Life Of Riley
description: Riley worked in an aircraft plant in California, but viewers usually saw him at home, cheerfully disrupting life with his malapropisms and ill timed intervention into minor problems.

videos.title: Babs' School Election
videos.overview: Babs is running for President of her college's freshman class. Riley attempts to provide unwanted assistance to her election campaign meet with predictable disaster.

videos.title: Riley's Gift from the Boss
videos.overview: Riley receives a letter from the president of the airplane plant in which he works, Cyrus P. Cunningham, announcing that the company will honor Riley's ten years of service with a luncheon in the boardroom the following day.

videos.title: Riley's New Suit
videos.overview: Riley needs a new suit. When his kids decide to surprise him with one, he begins thinking he's crazy because the only suit he has to use keeps disappearing.

videos.title: The Cake Contest
videos.overview: Riley replaces Peg's baking-contest entry with a store-bought cake.

videos.title: Riley's Kiss in the Dark
videos.overview: Riley tries determining the identity of a woman who kissed him in the dark.

videos.title: Riley Proves His Manhood
videos.overview: Peg goes to work in a run-down café.

videos.title: Riley's Sister Cissy
videos.overview: Riley makes a last-ditch attempt to marry off his sister Cissy.

videos.title: Riley and the Bean Contest
videos.overview: Riley goes all out to win a car in a bean-counting contest.

videos.title: Riley the Scoutmaster
videos.overview: Riley sets up as Scoutmaster when Junior's regular scoutmaster must take a leave of absence for the troop. Also, Riley sets out to show his wife that a man can do all the household duties in half the time a woman can.

videos.title: Riley Invades the Fight Game
videos.overview: Riley is pitted against boxer Lou Nova at a charity bazaar.

videos.title: Riley's Lost Weekend
videos.overview: The Rileys swap houses with "Square Head" Malloy for three days.

videos.title: Junior Wins the Soapbox Derby
videos.overview: Junior's efforts to build a racer are hampered by unwanted advice.

videos.title: Riley's Family Reunion
videos.overview: Riley's family is selected to appear in a radio program that brings parents and a child together for a family reunion - and plants hidden microphones throughout the house to capture their unrehearsed reactions to the event.

videos.title: Riley's Business Venture
videos.overview: Riley tries supplementing his wages by buying a hamburger stand.

videos.title: Riley Camps Out
videos.overview: Feeling that their families don't sufficiently appreciate them, Riley and Gillis decide to spend their vacation camping at a remote mountain cabin - and come to appreciate their lives back in the suburbs.

videos.title: Riley Steps Out
videos.overview: Riley picks up two banquet tickets discarded by his boss.

videos.title: Riley's Operation
videos.overview: Riley's sore throat is traced to his tonsils and he's ordered to have them removed. It's all his family and friends can do to get him to the hospital for his operation.

videos.title: Riley the Executive Type
videos.overview: Riley is dismayed when his spur-of-the-moment resignation is accepted.

videos.title: Riley Engages an Escort
videos.overview: Riley's efforts to secure a date for Babs to the Sadie Hawkins dance backfire.

videos.title: Riley Cultivates Babs
videos.overview: When Babs' friends see her out with Riley, rumors fly that she's dating a rich older man.

videos.title: Riley's Uncle Baxter
videos.overview: Peg's uncle captivates the Rileys with stories of his war heroism.

videos.title: Riley Outwits Cupid
videos.overview: Riley tries dissuading Babs from going steady.

videos.title: Riley Gets Engaged
videos.overview: At the laundromat Chester meets an attractive French miss upset over her visa expiration. The lady explains that if it appears that she's to be married she can stay. Riley becomes engaged to her but explaining to wife Peg is difficult.

videos.title: Riley Punishes Junior
videos.overview: Riley is named Father of the Month by his lodge.

videos.title: Riley Meets a Rival
videos.overview: Hoping to make Riley jealous, Peg invites an old flame for dinner.

videos.title: Riley the Typical Worker
videos.overview: A trip to Hawaii is offered to the most average employee where Riley is employed. Deciding he has the prize in the the bag Chester acts in ways that jeopardize his chances of winning.

videos.title: Riley's Stomach Ache
videos.overview: A series of mix-ups convinces Riley he is mortally ill.

videos.title: Riley, the Animal Lover
videos.overview: Riley learns that a cart horse he's fond of is to be "retired" so he purchases it. After he brings it home Peg insists Chester find a different place to keep it but he is at a loss as to what to do with the animal.

videos.title: Riley Faces Fatherhood
videos.overview: Gillis decides to play a joke on his friend Riley, leading Chester to believe Peg is expecting again. Riley is both worried and excited about being a dad again and Peg doesn't understand her husband's kind behavior.

videos.title: Peg's Birthday Present
videos.overview: Riley finds a fox wrap on the bus and takes it home to turn it into lost & found. He's forgotten it is Peg's birthday and she excitedly assumes the fur is her gift. Riley can't figure a way out of his predicament.

videos.title: Riley's Surprise Package
videos.overview: Riley's jealous nature backfires on him.

videos.title: Riley's Burning Ambition
videos.overview: Riley is temporarily named foreman at the aircraft plant. Is he up to the job?

videos.title: Riley's Separation
videos.overview: Babs wants to go alone to San Francisco but Riley doesn't like the idea. He suggests Peg act as her chaperone. When Gillis sees the Riley men backing it, he spreads the news that Peg left her husband, getting even Chester believing it.

videos.title: Riley the Worrier
videos.overview: Riley gets Babs a blind date.

videos.title: Riley Teaches Junior Boxing
videos.overview: Riley teaches Junior how to box and ends up in a 6 round match with Junior's teacher.

videos.title: Junior's Double Date
videos.overview: Junior has two dates for his first dance.

videos.title: Riley Brightens the Corner
videos.overview: Chester, in a burst of generosity, donates his family's beds to a charity mission. His plan to replace the furniture falls through and Riley has trouble explaining what happened to Peg and the kids.

videos.title: Riley and the Boss' Niece
videos.overview: Riley is a bundle of nerves, after he promises his boss, Mr. Cunningham, that he'll get a football player to escort his big homely niece to the school dance.

videos.title: Riley and the Beaux Arts Ball
Riley's Anniversary
videos.overview: Riley goes to great lengths to remember his anniversary.

videos.title: Junior's Secret
videos.overview: Junior and Egbert are interested in buying a sailboat but keep their dads out of the loop. After overhearing talk, Riley and Gillis thinks the boys are getting serious with girls. Pops plans on stopping the non-existent relationship.

videos.title: Riley in the Wild Blue Yonder
videos.overview: Riley has the notion to become a pilot and convinces his best friend Gillis to join in taking lessons. Over the protests of his family Riley perseveres with his idea until reality sets in.

videos.title: Riley and the Suggestion Contest
videos.overview: A suggestion box is installed at work and Riley is soon in trouble with all of his "helpful" ideas.

videos.title: Destination Brooklyn
videos.overview: The Riley's travel to Brooklyn to visit Chester's parents.

videos.title: The Dog Watch
videos.overview: Riley's boss Hawkins asks Chester to watch his dog. While under his care, the pooch runs away and Riley panics.

videos.title: Babs and Junior Try Home Economics
videos.overview: Chester's children get some ideas on how to save money in the family budget. Despite Peg's misgivings, he agrees to let Babs and Junior run things - but soon the household is in chaos.

videos.title: Riley Buys a Statue
videos.overview: Riley is out to prove he has cultural tastes and purchases an Indian statue. His family thinks it's hideous and Peg insists he get rid of it. Riley finds no takers when he tries first to sell it, then give the "artwork" away.

videos.title: Riley Versus Numerology
videos.overview: Riley's friend Waldo follows numerology and after a certain occurrences Chester becomes a believer also. His family remains skeptical and begin to be annoyed when Chester insists on certain rituals.

videos.title: Riley, the Friendly Neighbor
videos.overview: When the neighbors find out Chester is willing to store a couple of items in his garage they take advantage of the situation. Soon the Rileys are overwhelmed with other's belongings and Peg issues an ultimatum.

videos.title: Puppy Love
videos.overview: Junior has his first major crush and Chester gives him a heart to heart about relationships. When Peg learns of her husband's views on marriage she's not happy and Riley scrambles to fix the mess he made.

videos.title: The Car Pool
videos.overview: Chester believes he can make some extra cash by organizing car pools. It goes wrong in so many ways with everyone involved mad at Chester for another hare brained scheme.

videos.title: Job Opening
videos.overview: Riley and Gillis are competing for the same promotion which endangers their close friendship.

videos.title: Unwelcome Guests
videos.overview: Chester is asked to watch the Gillis home while the family is away. Riley sees a chance to make some extra money and rents the house to a circus family. The carnies turn the neighborhood upside down and Riley is befuddled.

videos.title: Come Back, Little Junior
videos.overview: Riley is worried about money so he and Gillis ask their sons to contribute. Junior and Egbert runaway but an encounter with a hobo sends the boys back home. Promises are made by the worried dads, not knowing the kids are back.

videos.title: Riley Buys a Wrestler
videos.overview: Riley is given the task of finding a wrestler to take on the company champion. He is first made to buy the athlete's contract then Chester finds he must house and feed the man before the match. His family vehemently objects.

videos.title: Light-fingered Babs
videos.overview: Chester and Peg notice Babs has many new things but no source of money to buy them. Riley suspects his daughter has been shoplifting the items and goes to unusual lengths to stop her criminal behavior.

videos.title: Chicken Ranch
videos.overview: Riley's parents are visiting but are anxious to get back home to Brooklyn. But, Chester likes them being nearby so he buys his folks a chicken ranch to operate despite the city background.

videos.title: Up to the Jury
videos.overview: Chester is excited when wife Peg is selected to be a juror in an important trial. Despite being warned, Riley gets himself involved and ends up jeopardizing the case.

videos.title: Look Peg, I'm Dancing
videos.overview: Once a year Riley and his pal give their wives a treat by taking them dancing -- but this year the girls insist the guys take dancing lessons first.

videos.title: Brotherhood of the B.P.L.A.
videos.overview: Pa Riley is visiting but is eager to get back to Brooklyn. Chester thinks that if he gets his dad to join Chester's lodge that he will have more incentive to stay.

videos.title: Out to Pasture
videos.overview: Riley is to train a young Jack Clifford in his job and he catches on quickly. Riley jumps to conclusions thinking he's about to be fired so he resigns instead. When Riley realizes his mistake, he frantically tries to fix his predicament.

videos.title: Top Secret
videos.overview: Riley and Gillis are assigned to a special project and are told to keep quiet about it. Riley ends up boasting about the secret project, which lands him in major trouble.

videos.title: The Stupid Cupid
videos.overview: Otto's romance has ended which leaves him understandably saddened. Riley and Gillis work to cheer their friend up but the two men make things worse.

videos.title: The Marines Have Landed
videos.overview: Babs is worried when she hasn't heard from her marine boyfriend for awhile. Riley comes up with an outrageous scheme to cheer his little girl up which goes wrong and makes things worse.

videos.title: Love Comes to Waldo Binney
videos.overview: Waldo Binny's sister, Mrs. Lindsey, knocks on Riley door looking for her brother. She wants Waldo to babysit her son, Drake, for the weekend but Waldo is hiding because he knows his little nephew is a monster. Besides, Waldo has a big date tonight with his new love, Millicent. Mrs. Lindsey leaves Drake in Riley's care but now no one wants responsibility to babysit the difficult child.

videos.title: Do It Yourself
videos.overview: Having promised a fishing trip to Hawkins, and then forgetting to rent a boat, Riley and Otto borrow Muley's rowboat, but wreck it. They then turn to attempting to assemble a prefab boat, but stupidly put it together in Riley's parlor.

videos.title: Dudley the Burglar
videos.overview: Chester has misplaced his watch and Dudley puts it in a vase for safekeeping. Riley gets the notion he is a thief from his actions and intends to not only reform his pal from his life of crime, but also get his timepiece back.

videos.title: Ghost Town
videos.overview: Chester fakes a backache and his boss gives him the entire week off. Riley looks forward to his surprise vacation but things don't go as planned, much to his disappointment.

videos.title: The Famous Chester A. Riley, Junior
videos.overview: Junior has success on the football field and he lets the praise go to his head. The Riley parents wonder how to handle their son but Junior had his ego deflated in awkward circumstances.

videos.title: Riley, the Tycoon
videos.overview: Riley gets an unexpected day off from the airplane plant and decides to spend it in the park. Chester's appearance and behavior lead to mistaken ideas about his financial situation.

videos.title: Repeat Performance
videos.overview: Riley and Peg plan surprise anniversary parties for each other....on the same night.

videos.title: Waldo's Mother
videos.overview: To prevent his mother from moving in, Waldo announces he's engaged.

videos.title: Babs's Wedding
videos.overview: It's Babs' wedding day and its hard to tell who's more nervous - Chester A. Riley or his daughter, the bride.

videos.title: Riley's Raffle
videos.overview: Riley thinks it's time the family had a second auto and he will sacrifice his motorcycle to make it happen. Chester holds a raffle for his bike but he befuddles the idea and his plan starts to unravel.

videos.title: Junior Quits School
videos.overview: Riley's task: persuading Junior to complete his education.

videos.title: The Tree That Grew in Brooklyn
His Brother-In-Law's Keeper
videos.overview: Riley shelters his brother-in-law, a compulsive gambler.

videos.title: Expectantly Yours
videos.overview: Babs leaves out an instruction list from her doctor and Chester finds it. He jumps to the conclusion that Don's mother is expecting. Babs struggles to clear up the misunderstanding and tell her dad his little girl is having a baby.

videos.title: A Wire for Gillis
videos.overview: Gillis gets a telegram from out of the blue and is secretive about its contents. Riley speculates wildly that his friend came into money and gets mad at Jim for being so mysterious.

videos.title: The First Quarrel
videos.overview: Don wants to go fishing with his buddies and Babs gets upset that her new husband wants to spend time away from her. Despite being warned, Riley gets involved in the newlywed's marital troubles.

videos.title: Destination Del Mar Vista
videos.overview: The Riley and Gillis families are looking for a new place to live. They find the perfect two house arrangement and move in after arguing about who lives where. The Rileys discover downstairs comes with a tenant, landlord Mr. Winkley.

videos.title: Friends Are Where You Find Them
videos.overview: Furious with one another after arguing, best friends Riley and Gillis compete to meet other people and make new friends.

videos.title: Juvenile Delinquent
videos.overview: Chester worries when Junior trades his car for a hot rod. Junior and friends just wanted a safe place to race but Chester ruins their plans to use an unused Cunningham runway. Chester assumes he's fired after he fixes his mess.

videos.title: Riley's Lonely Night
videos.overview: A lonely Riley wanders in to a wild party.

videos.title: A Man's Pride
videos.overview: When Riley confronts foreman Hawkins on the factory floor and angrily demands a raise, Hawkins insists he apologize for his rude behavior. Riley refuses to apologize so Hawkins fires him on the spot. Now Riley is looking for a new job and each expect the other to offer an apology.

videos.title: Riley Hires a Nurse
videos.overview: With Babs expecting, Chester decides to become involved in planning day-care for his soon-to-be-grandchild. However, when he attends a "baby nursing course" that he thought would be for nurses, he discovers that it is instead a class for mothers. Complications ensue.

videos.title: Blessed Event
videos.overview: Riley and Gillis march in the Brooklyn Patriots of Los Angeles parade and get soaked when rains. Riley stays home in bed the following day to prevent catching pneumonia while Peg tends to Babs. When Peg takes Babs to the hospital for delivery, Riley rushes over in his pajamas and is mistaken for a loose patient. Babs delivers a healthy baby boy among all the chaos.

videos.title: Benefit for Egbert
videos.overview: Egbert is stranded in Chicago without the cash to get home. As a surprise to his friends Gillis and Honeybee, Riley holds a fundraiser to get Egbert home to California.

videos.title: Honeybee's Mother
videos.overview: Honeybee's mother comes for a visit but because she can't climb stairs the mother-in-law stays in the Riley's home. Chester is soon exasperated by the difficult to please woman.

videos.title: World's Greatest Grandson
videos.overview: Riley believes that his new grandson is the greatest baby ever and won't stop talking about how amazing he is. The constant bragging is starting to create a strain on the guys at work.

videos.title: Riley Wins a Trip
videos.overview: There's a grand opening celebration at a new Friendly Franklyn's Grocery Store and they're giving away an all-expense paid vacation to Hawaii. Customers get a numbered ticket each time they buy groceries so, to get more tickets, Riley grocery shops one item at a time.

videos.title: Aloha Riley, Goodbye
videos.overview: The Honolulu police are questioning Riley about a crime and possible murder. The Riley's and the Gillis' have spent three weeks in Hawaii and are getting ready to return to Los Angeles. But first, they need to buy gifts for friends and family and end-up involved with two con-men who try to scam them.

videos.title: Change in Command
videos.overview: Hawkins tells Riley and Gillis that he's no longer foreman, their old friend, Otto Schmidlap, is the new foreman. But the secret is, Otto is only temporary foreman while Hawkins is on vacation. Riley and Gillis devise a plan to make Otto look more capable so he will be made their full-time foreman, but the plan takes a wrong turn.

videos.title: Deep in the Heart of...
videos.overview: Millionaire Houston Dodsworth is up from Texas to see Gillis and offer him $5000 for the piece of land they share. Riley botches the deal when he tell Dodsworth that Gillis is a millionaire himself. Gillis is furious, so Riley contacts Dodsworth to rearrange the sale, only now the deal includes Gillis playing in a upcoming polo match.

videos.title: Foreign Intrigue
videos.overview: Zsa Zsa Gabor plays a voluptuous maid who disrupts the Riley and Gillis homes.

videos.title: Getting Riley's Goat
videos.overview: Junior brings home a goat for a ten day 4-H project. Chester finds himself tangling with the stubborn animal and trying to keep the goat from eating everything around.

videos.title: A Young Man's Fancy
videos.overview: Riley steps in when he suspects Junior is dating an older woman.

videos.title: Babs's Dream House
videos.overview: Babs tells Peg that she and her husband have hired a famous architect to design their new home. Riley isn't convinced that the designer knows his business and soon the two men are butting heads over the project's blueprints.

videos.title: A Watch for Gillis
videos.overview: Riley sets out to buy a cheap watch for Gillis but ends up buying an expensive watch and Peg is not happy. He goes back to the jewelry shop to buy an expensive watch for Peg but Gillis thinks it's for Honeybee's birthday. Honeybee ends-up with the watch and now Peg is really upset. So back Riley goes to the Jeweler to buy his 3rd expensive watch.

videos.title: A Day at the Beach
videos.overview: The Gillis and Riley couples look forward to some relaxation after getting time off. They head to the beach where the boys look forward to getting in some fishing. With Chester involved, the time proves to be anything but stress free.

videos.title: A House Divided
videos.overview: After a dispute, the Riley family is evicted. Chester convinces Gillis to be an obnoxious neighbor so his former home goes unrented. Chester's plan backfires as Jim and Honeybee become homeless also.

videos.title: Return to Blue View
videos.overview: Riley and Gillis are purchasing the duplex they're renting as joint-owners but Riley can't find the bonds needed for his down payment. He believes his hid them in his old house in Blue View Terrace, which is currently owned by two sisters. He and Gillis go back to the house and enlist the help of their old friend, Waldo Binny, to recover the bonds

videos.title: The Stray Dog
videos.overview: Riley adopts a stray dog named Baskerville but the dog howls at night causing a disturbance. An angry and sleep-deprived Gillis counters with a rooster for a pet and now a petition is going around to force the two noisy families out of the neighborhood.

videos.title: Vacation Plans
videos.overview: Riley and Gillis are gathering items for their annual camping vacation together. Except this year, at the last minute, Riley gets an invitation to use a luxury beach house and Gillis is invited to an all-expense paid stay at a Texas Dude Ranch. Now, each have to figure how to get out of their vacation commitment with the other.

videos.title: Homeless Otto
videos.overview: Riley and Gillis ask for, then unexpectedly receive, raises so they convince Otto to do the same. Otto though is fired and his two buddies feel responsible, so they scheme to get Otto his job back.

videos.title: Summer Job for Junior
videos.overview: Chester is afraid Junior is going to be unemployed for the summer, so dad puts a $50 deposit on a busboy job. Junior has a better paying position at a logging camp lined up, so Chester tries to get his money back.

videos.title: The New Den
videos.overview: Peg decides to turn a spare room into a den creating chaos in the Riley household, most of it caused by Chester.

videos.title: Gillis' Childhood Friend
videos.overview: An old buddy of Jim arrives on the scene and Gillis starts spending all his spare time with the friend. Chester feels lonely and angry but his efforts to intrude create awkward moments.

videos.title: Down for the Count
videos.overview: Contest enthusiast Riley applies a scientific method to determine the number of beans in a jar.

videos.title: The Gruesome Twosome
videos.overview: Peg and Honeybee take golf lessons so they can join the husbands in their outdoor activities. Chester and Jim are against the notion so they come up with devious plan to derail their wives' plans.

videos.title: Happy Birthday, Little Chester
videos.overview: Riley's party for baby Chester boomerangs.

videos.title: Nobody Down Here Likes Me
videos.overview: Riley becomes a recluse when his friends refuse to go fishing with him.

videos.title: A Trip for Peg
videos.overview: Peg is upset because Junior has moved out to the Fleming House on the college campus. To cheer her up, Riley insists she goes to the beauty parlor for the works then buy a new outfit. He intends to send her on vacation to Brooklyn to visit his brother and family. The only problem is, his brother's daughter, Annie from Brooklyn, shows up at their door on a mission to cheer Peg up.

videos.title: Going Steady
videos.overview: Junior has college finals coming up and needs private time to study without any distractions so he decides not to date his girlfriend Bobby for the next two weeks. Bobby agrees and now it becomes Riley's job to keep the hungry dating wolves away from Junior and Bobby until Junior completes his assignments.

videos.title: Little Awful Annie
videos.overview: The food bill soars when Annie falls for heavy-eating Moose.

videos.title: Bowling Beauties
videos.overview: Cunningham Aircraft has hired an efficiency expert, Walter Bellflower, to improve the recreational program for the employees. Walter has assigned Riley and Gillis to coach the new ladies bowling team; four old, rough-looking gals. But there's been a mistake, so Walter reassigns the boys to another team of young good looking beauties.

videos.title: The Letter
videos.overview: Chester and Gillis persuade a discontented pal to leave his job, and they lend their assistance as he writes a letter of resignation.

videos.title: Ten O'Clock Scholar
videos.overview: Riley enrolls in night school to obtain his high-school diploma.

videos.title: The Oily Birds
videos.overview: Based on their duplex agreement, Riley owns the grounds plus the maintenance and Gillis is responsible for the roof. But Riley is getting tired of doing all the yard work so he starts a rumor that oil has been discovered on their property. When Gillis hears about the oil, he becomes anxious to share in some of the yard work.

videos.title: Mrs. Aircraft Industries
videos.overview: Babs is entered in the Mrs. Aircraft Industries beauty contest.

videos.title: After You're Gone
videos.overview: Riley decides to be more generous to Peg.

videos.title: Riley's Burst Bubble
videos.overview: Riley schemes to reunite Annie with her father.

videos.title: Teenage Troubles
videos.overview: Riley schemes to prevent other boys from dating Junior's girlfriend.

videos.title: The Price of Fame
videos.overview: Riley becomes a hero when he captures a thief.

videos.title: Annie's Radio Romance
videos.overview: Annie loves to listen to her favorite radio program, "The Lonesome Guy", starring Charles Chambers. The program is offering a romantic evening out with the lonesome guy for some lucky love starved woman and Annie wins the contest. Unfortunately, it turns out that the "lonesome guy" is not as appealing as his silky voice would imply.

videos.title: Dudley Comes to Town
videos.overview: Calvin Dudley returns for a visit and ropes Riley and Gillis into a phony money-making scheme.

videos.title: Here Comes Constance
videos.overview: Riley and Gillis balk at attending cultural events with their wives.
